mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `flow_instance` WHERE id = #{instanceId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT fi.id, fi.definition_id, fi.business_id, fd.name, fd.code, fi.category, fi.user_id AS start_user_id, fi.current_node_key, fi.current_node_name, fi.status, fi.start_time, fi.end_time FROM flow_instance fi INNER JOIN flow_definition fd ON fd.id = fi.definition_id AND fd.org_id = fi.org_id
ORDER BY fi.start_time DESC, fi.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fi.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS running, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fi.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fi.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fi.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled FROM flow_instance fi INNER JOIN flow_definition fd ON fd.id = fi.definition_id AND fd.org_id = fi.org_id
